verdict.rationale: The story is satisfied by any of its listed paths. CoreWeave AI Object Storage provides documented S3-compatible access to GPU compute, the LOTA accelerator speeds object transfer to GPU and CPU nodes (including cache warming), and the Cloud Console supports uploading and downloading objects, so data can move both in and out through the product's own capabilities. Missing for 10: no evidence of cloud-storage sync or migration tooling from other clouds, no in-depth transfer-tooling docs (e.g., CLI or bulk-transfer guides), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of transfer efficiency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling

citations.quote: Store training data, checkpoints, and model weights with efficient S3-compatible access directly to your GPU compute resources.
CPU-only clusters can now use the LOTA endpoint for accelerated object storage access.
Training jobs that start with a warm cache can see a 30-50% faster first epoch compared to cold reads.
You can now browse, upload, download, and manage objects in CoreWeave AI Object Storage buckets directly from the CoreWeave Cloud Console
LOTA is now available in clusters with any mix of Node types, including CPU-only clusters.
